title: Mathematical foundation for n-th derivative
description: Analyze the cyclic derivative pattern for sin and cos functions. The n-th derivative follows a periodic pattern: d^n/dx^n sin(x) = sin(x + n*pi/2) and d^n/dx^n cos(x) = cos(x + n*pi/2). For sin, derivatives cycle: sin→cos→(-sin)→(-cos)→sin (period 4). For cos, derivatives cycle: cos→(-sin)→(-cos)→sin→cos (period 4). The implementation should use this angle-shift formula for efficient computation.
expected_output: Mathematical formulas documenting the n-th derivative pattern for sin and cos functions, including the angle-shift implementation approach: sin(arg + n*pi/2) and cos(arg + n*pi/2).
